title: Learning from Next-Frame Prediction: Towards Unified and Scalable Visual Representation Learning
title_zh: 从下一帧预测中学习：迈向统一且可扩展的视觉表示学习

paragraphs.en: Video provides a natural source of supervision: what happens next serves as a learning signal for visual world modeling. Yet masked video pretraining focuses on recovering missing content from surrounding context rather than predicting the future from the past. Autoregressive methods instead predict forward one token at a time, but have yet to match joint-embedding methods in representation quality. This gap motivates us to revisit the granularity and space of future prediction. In this work, we introduce VANE , a self-supervised visual pretraining framework built on next-frame prediction in embedding space. A causal encoder summarizes past observations for a state predictor that infers the representation of the entire next frame, making temporal evolution the primary learning signal. This prediction is carried out in a fixed embedding space provided by a frozen semantic tokenizer, emphasizing scene content and structure. To retain fine-grained spatial detail alongside semantic content, a lightweight auxiliary generative decoder reconstructs future-frame patches conditioned on the predicted representations. To unify visual modeling across images and videos, we construct a local-to-global crop sequence for still images, allowing the same encoder to predict newly revealed regions from earlier crops under the same objective. Experiments show that VANE improves with model and data scaling, achieving SOTA on most anticipation, recognition, and dense perception benchmarks among unified encoders. Especially on EPIC-KITCHENS-100 action anticipation, it surpasses V-JEPA 2.1 by 7.1 points in mean-class recall@5. These results demonstrate that next-frame prediction in embedding space is effective and scalable for visual world modeling.

paragraphs.en: Humans come to understand the world by watching it unfold, mapping a continuous stream of sensory input into a stable sense of objects, motion, and events. What they acquire is not merely a catalogue of appearances, but an internal model of how the world evolves ( Rao and Ballard, 1999 ; LeCun, 2022 ) : what a scene contains, what is happening within it, and what is likely to happen next. Video captures the world in precisely this form, with temporal order providing a natural learning signal that requires no annotation. Predicting what comes next therefore requires a model to represent both the appearance and the dynamics of the visual world.

paragraphs.en: Yet most video pretraining methods do not learn by predicting what comes next. Masked video models ( Feichtenhofer et al., 2022 ) , such as VideoMAE ( Tong et al., 2022 ) , hide a large fraction of spatiotemporal patches and reconstruct their pixels from the visible ones ( He et al., 2022 ) . Joint-embedding methods ( Assran et al., 2023 ) , such as V-JEPA ( Bardes et al., 2024 ; Assran et al., 2025 ) , likewise mask part of the video, but predict representations of the masked regions instead of their pixels (Fig. 1 a). Both remain forms of contextual recovery: the model infers what is missing from surrounding observations rather than predicting the future from the past. Autoregressive pretraining ( Chen et al., 2020 ; El-Nouby et al., 2024 ) , extended to video by Toto ( Rajasegaran et al., 2025 ) , instead predicts forward in time by treating video as a sequence of visual tokens and learning through next-token prediction. While viable and scalable, this formulation has not matched joint-embedding methods in representation quality ( Rajasegaran et al., 2025 ) . This raises a central question: at what granularity, and in what space, should the future be predicted?

paragraphs.en: In this work, we answer this question with VANE, a self-supervised visual pretraining framework built on next-frame prediction in embedding space . Specifically, VANE shifts prediction from individual tokens to the frame level and performs it in a semantic representation space. At the frame level, the distinction between spatial and temporal structure becomes explicit: structure within a frame is largely spatial, whereas changes across consecutive frames capture how objects, actions, and scenes evolve over time. Frame-level prediction therefore places temporal evolution at the center of the learning objective, rather than devoting much of the objective to completing individual tokens within the same frame. Additionally, prediction is carried out in semantic embedding space, building on the principle of joint-embedding learning ( Assran et al., 2023 ; Bardes et al., 2024 ) . Semantic representations emphasize the higher-level content and structure of a scene, allowing the model to focus on the aspects of the visual world that persist and evolve over time.
paragraphs.zh: 在本工作中，我们用 VANE 回答了这个问题，VANE 是一个基于嵌入空间中下一帧预测的自监督视觉预训练框架。 具体而言，VANE 将预测从单个 token 转移到帧级别，并在语义表示空间中进行预测。 在帧级别上，空间结构与时间结构之间的区别变得明确：帧内的结构主要是空间性的，而连续帧之间的变化则捕捉物体、动作和场景如何随时间演变。 因此，帧级别预测将时间演变置于学习目标的核心，而不是将学习目标的大部分用于补全同一帧内的单个 token。 此外，预测是在语义嵌入空间中进行的，这建立在联合嵌入学习的原则之上（Assran et al., 2023；Bardes et al., 2024）。 语义表示强调场景更高层次的内容和结构，使模型能够专注于视觉世界中那些持续存在并随时间演变的方面。

paragraphs.en: We instantiate this objective with four components (Fig. 1 b). A causal encoder summarizes the observed history through frame-causal attention, with each frame attending only to itself and preceding frames. From this temporal context, a state predictor infers the representation of the next frame. A frozen semantic tokenizer, implemented as a pretrained image encoder ( Oquab et al., 2024 ) , provides a fixed semantic space in which future scene content and structure are predicted. As in generative models operating in fixed latent spaces ( Rombach et al., 2022 ) , we keep the tokenizer frozen to provide fixed prediction targets and support stable optimization. Finally, a lightweight generative decoder reconstructs each future-frame patch conditioned on its predicted embedding. This auxiliary reconstruction objective complements semantic prediction by encouraging the model to learn representations that preserve fine-grained spatial detail.

paragraphs.en: To unify visual modeling across images and videos, we extend the same predictive objective to still images. Unlike videos, still images lack a temporal order, so we introduce local-to-global observation : each image is presented as a sequence of local-to-global crops, and the model predicts representations of newly revealed regions in the next crop from preceding crops, just as it predicts the next frame from preceding frames in video. This enables joint image–video training, yielding a unified visual encoder without separate pretraining stages or modality-specific objectives.
paragraphs.zh: 为了在图像和视频之间统一视觉建模，我们将相同的预测目标扩展到静态图像。 与视频不同，静态图像缺乏时间顺序，因此我们引入局部到全局的观测方式：每张图像被呈现为一个由局部到全局的裁剪序列，模型根据前面的裁剪预测下一个裁剪中新显现区域的表征，正如它在视频中根据前面的帧预测下一帧一样。 这使得图像与视频可以联合训练，从而得到一个统一的视觉编码器，无需单独的预训练阶段或针对特定模态的目标函数。

paragraphs.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that VANE unifies predictive and perceptual understanding within a single pretrained visual model. VANE achieves state-of-the-art performance among unified image–video encoders on most evaluated benchmarks spanning anticipation, global recognition, and dense perception. On EPIC-KITCHENS-100 ( Damen et al., 2022 ) , VANE achieves 45.5 action mean-class recall@5, improving over V-JEPA 2.1 ( Mur-Labadia et al., 2026 ) by 7.1 points. Beyond its broad transferability, VANE scales consistently with both model capacity and pretraining data. paragraphs.en: Masked visual pretraining. Masked visual pretraining learns representations by recovering content withheld from an observation. Building on masked autoencoding ( He et al., 2022 ) , VideoMAE ( Tong et al., 2022 ; Wang et al., 2023a ) and MAE-ST ( Feichtenhofer et al., 2022 ) reconstruct masked spatiotemporal patches in pixel space, while the InternVideo series ( Wang et al., 2022 ; Wang et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025 ) incorporates masked modeling into broader video pretraining frameworks. The Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) ( LeCun, 2022 ) formulates prediction in representation space rather than pixel space. I-JEPA ( Assran et al., 2023 ) instantiates this principle for images, while the V-JEPA family ( Bardes et al., 2024 ; Assran et al., 2025 ; Mur-Labadia et al., 2026 ) extends it to video, scaling masked feature prediction and improving global and dense representations. Related methods distill pretrained visual features ( Wang et al., 2023b ; Li et al., 2023b ) , and Rethinking JEPA ( Li et al., 2026 ) shows that a frozen target encoder can support effective masked latent prediction. InternVideo-Next ( Wang et al., 2026 ) combines semantic alignment, generative reconstruction, and fixed-target feature prediction within a two-stage masked modeling framework. Despite differences in target construction and supervision, these pretraining objectives remain centered on recovering or matching content within the observed clip rather than explicitly predicting its temporal continuation. By predicting future-frame embeddings from past observations, VANE makes temporal evolution central to pretraining while preserving fine-grained spatial structure through auxiliary reconstruction.

paragraphs.en: Autoregressive and predictive visual learning. Autoregressive visual pretraining depends on how visual observations are represented and ordered. iGPT ( Chen et al., 2020 ) and AIM ( El-Nouby et al., 2024 ) predict pixels or patches, while Toto ( Rajasegaran et al., 2025 ) learns from images and videos through next-token prediction over discrete visual codes. Alternative formulations vary the prediction order, granularity, or target space: ARVideo ( Ren et al., 2025 ) randomizes spatiotemporal ordering, VAR ( Tian et al., 2024 ) predicts progressively finer-resolution token maps, and NEPA ( Xu et al., 2025 ) predicts successive image patch embeddings with stop-gradient targets. A complementary line learns from future visual features through regression ( Vondrick et al., 2016 ) or contrastive objectives ( van den Oord et al., 2018 ; Han et al., 2019 ) . More recently, DINO-Foresight ( Karypidis et al., 2025 ) and DINO-world ( Baldassarre et al., 2025 ) forecast future features for scene understanding, while DINO-WM ( Zhou et al., 2025 ) uses action-conditioned feature prediction for planning. Causal-JEPA ( Nam et al., 2026 ) explores object-level latent masking to learn interaction-aware dynamics. These recent world models learn prediction on top of pretrained visual encoders that remain fixed during dynamics learning. VANE instead uses next-frame embedding prediction to train the causal encoder itself, extending the same objective to unified image–video pretraining through local-to-global image views.

paragraphs.en: Implementation details. Our main model pairs a 1B-parameter ViT-g encoder with a frozen DINOv2 ViT-L ( Oquab et al., 2024 ) semantic tokenizer. It is pretrained on VISTA , our curated image–video corpus, which combines public image datasets (ImageNet-21K ( Deng et al., 2009 ) , SA-1B ( Kirillov et al., 2023 ) ) and video datasets (SSv2 ( Goyal et al., 2017 ) , K710 ( Kay et al., 2017 ; Li et al., 2023a ) , HowTo100M ( Miech et al., 2019 ) ) with additional retrieved and class-balanced data. Training proceeds in four stages: warm-up and base pretraining on 16-frame clips at 256 × 256 256\times 256 , long-video post-training on 64-frame clips, and a high-resolution cooldown at 384 × 384 384\times 384 . The first two stages take about 26.6k GPU-hours and the last two a further 30.7k.

paragraphs.en: We first examine whether next-frame pretraining supports anticipation, on action anticipation (EK100) and short-term object-interaction anticipation (Ego4D).

paragraphs.en: Action anticipation. On EPIC-KITCHENS-100 (EK100) ( Damen et al., 2022 ) , we follow the V-JEPA 2.1 ( Mur-Labadia et al., 2026 ) protocol with a one-second anticipation gap and report mean-class recall@5 on the validation set. The attentive probe uses only frozen encoder features; the state predictor is not used. VANE reaches 45.5 on actions, exceeding the 1B V-JEPA 2.1 and V-JEPA 2 by 7.1 and 5.8 points, respectively (Table 1 ), with the largest gain on nouns (67.6 vs. 56.2). It also outperforms the 8B PlausiVL by 17.9 points. These gains suggest that next-frame prediction in embedding space encourages representations that capture how visual events evolve and what is likely to happen next.
paragraphs.zh: 动作预判。 在 EPIC-KITCHENS-100 (EK100) (Damen et al., 2022) 上，我们遵循 V-JEPA 2.1 (Mur-Labadia et al., 2026) 的协议，采用一秒的预判间隔，并在验证集上报告平均类别召回率@5。 注意力探针仅使用冻结编码器的特征；不使用状态预测器。 VANE 在动作上达到 45.5，分别超过 1B 的 V-JEPA 2.1 和 V-JEPA 2 达 7.1 和 5.8 分（表 1），其中在名词上的提升最大（67.6 对 56.2）。 它还超过 8B 的 PlausiVL 达 17.9 分。 这些提升表明，在嵌入空间中进行下一帧预测能促使表示捕捉视觉事件如何演化以及接下来可能发生什么。

paragraphs.en: To assess recognition beyond anticipation, we evaluate image classification on IN1K ( Deng et al., 2009 ) and action recognition on K400, SSv2, and Diving-48 ( Kay et al., 2017 ; Goyal et al., 2017 ; Li et al., 2018 ) . Following V-JEPA 2.1, we train four-layer attentive probes on frozen features with 256 × 256 256\times 256 inputs and report top-1 accuracy. Under the same protocol, VANE outperforms V-JEPA 2.1 on all four benchmarks, by 3.8 points on IN1K, 2.4 on K400, 0.6 on SSv2, and 0.7 on Diving-48, raising the average from 83.6 to 85.4 (Table 3 ); V-JEPA 2 remains slightly better on Diving-48 (90.1 vs. 89.7). VANE also exceeds the published results of Toto, which autoregressively predicts future visual tokens, by 12.2 points on IN1K and 14.2 on K400. Against image encoders, VANE nearly matches DINOv3 ViT-H+ on IN1K (87.5 vs. 88.2) while exceeding it by 12.8 points on SSv2 (75.9 vs. 63.1), suggesting that unified image–video pretraining retains appearance understanding while adding motion understanding. Notably, it also surpasses DINOv2 ViT-g, a larger variant of its own frozen tokenizer, by 25.2 points on SSv2 (75.9 vs. 50.7), indicating that next-frame prediction learns temporal structure absent from its targets.
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估超出预期的识别能力，我们在 IN1K 上评估图像分类，并在 K400、SSv2 和 Diving-48 上评估动作识别（Kay 等，2017；Goyal 等，2017；Li 等，2018）。 按照 V-JEPA 2.1 的做法，我们在冻结特征上训练四层注意力探针，输入为 256 × 256 256\times 256，并报告 top-1 准确率。 在相同协议下，VANE 在全部四个基准上都优于 V-JEPA 2.1，在 IN1K 上高 3.8 分，在 K400 上高 2.4 分，在 SSv2 上高 0.6 分，在 Diving-48 上高 0.7 分，将平均分从 83.6 提升到 85.4（表 3）；V-JEPA 2 在 Diving-48 上仍略好（90.1 对 89.7）。 VANE 还超过了 Toto 的已发表结果，后者以自回归方式预测未来视觉 token，VANE 在 IN1K 上高出 12.2 分，在 K400 上高出 14.2 分。 与图像编码器相比，VANE 在 IN1K 上接近 DINOv3 ViT-H+（87.5 对 88.2），同时在 SSv2 上超出其 12.8 分（75.9 对 63.1），这表明统一的图像—视频预训练在保留外观理解的同时增加了运动理解。 值得注意的是，它还超过 DINOv2 ViT-g——即其自身冻结分词器的更大变体——在 SSv2 上高出 25.2 分（75.9 对 50.7），表明下一帧预测学到了其目标中不存在的时序结构。

paragraphs.en: To assess spatial detail beyond global recognition, we evaluate semantic segmentation on ADE20K, Cityscapes, and VOC ( Zhou et al., 2017 ; Cordts et al., 2016 ; Everingham et al., 2010 ) and monocular depth estimation on NYUv2 and KITTI ( Silberman et al., 2012 ; Geiger et al., 2012 ) . Following DINOv3 ( Siméoni et al., 2025 ) and V-JEPA 2.1 ( Mur-Labadia et al., 2026 ) , we train a dense linear projection on frozen final-layer patch features for each task and report mIoU for segmentation and RMSE for depth. Compared with V-JEPA 2.1 (Table 4 ), VANE improves ADE20K and Cityscapes by 3.2 and 3.6 mIoU, respectively, while remaining comparable on VOC (84.5 vs. 84.7). It also reduces depth RMSE from 0.350 to 0.329 on NYUv2 and from 2.601 to 2.431 on KITTI, the lowest errors among all encoders in Table 4 , including image encoders. Since these benchmarks consist of still images, we attribute the gains mainly to next-crop prediction and the generative decoder, both of which improve ADE20K in our ablations (Table 5 b,c). Figure 4 further shows that VANE produces cleaner and more coherent segments than V-JEPA 2.1.
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估超越全局识别的空间细节能力，我们在 ADE20K、Cityscapes 和 VOC（Zhou et al., 2017；Cordts et al., 2016；Everingham et al., 2010）上评估语义分割，并在 NYUv2 和 KITTI（Silberman et al., 2012；Geiger et al., 2012）上评估单目深度估计。 遵循 DINOv3（Siméoni et al., 2025）和 V-JEPA 2.1（Mur-Labadia et al., 2026），我们在冻结的末层 patch 特征上为每个任务训练一个稠密线性投影，并报告分割的 mIoU 和深度估计的 RMSE。 与 V-JEPA 2.1 相比（表 4），VANE 在 ADE20K 和 Cityscapes 上分别提升了 3.2 和 3.6 mIoU，同时在 VOC 上保持相当的水平（84.5 对 84.7）。 它还将 NYUv2 上的深度 RMSE 从 0.350 降低到 0.329，将 KITTI 上的从 2.601 降低到 2.431，是表 4 中所有编码器（包括图像编码器）中误差最低的。 由于这些基准由静态图像组成，我们将这些提升主要归因于 next-crop 预测和生成式解码器，二者在我们的消融实验中都改善了 ADE20K 的结果（表 5b、c）。 图 4 进一步表明，VANE 生成的分割结果比 V-JEPA 2.1 更干净、更连贯。

sents.en: Following DINOv3 ( Siméoni et al., 2025 ) and V-JEPA 2.1 ( Mur-Labadia et al., 2026 ) , we train a dense linear projection on frozen final-layer patch features for each task and report mIoU for segmentation and RMSE for depth.
sents.zh: 遵循 DINOv3（Siméoni et al., 2025）和 V-JEPA 2.1（Mur-Labadia et al., 2026），我们在冻结的末层 patch 特征上为每个任务训练一个稠密线性投影，并报告分割的 mIoU 和深度估计的 RMSE。

sents.en: Compared with V-JEPA 2.1 (Table 4 ), VANE improves ADE20K and Cityscapes by 3.2 and 3.6 mIoU, respectively, while remaining comparable on VOC (84.5 vs. 84.7).
sents.zh: 与 V-JEPA 2.1 相比（表 4），VANE 在 ADE20K 和 Cityscapes 上分别提升了 3.2 和 3.6 mIoU，同时在 VOC 上保持相当的水平（84.5 对 84.7）。

sents.en: It also reduces depth RMSE from 0.350 to 0.329 on NYUv2 and from 2.601 to 2.431 on KITTI, the lowest errors among all encoders in Table 4 , including image encoders.
sents.zh: 它还将 NYUv2 上的深度 RMSE 从 0.350 降低到 0.329，将 KITTI 上的从 2.601 降低到 2.431，是表 4 中所有编码器（包括图像编码器）中误差最低的。

sents.en: Since these benchmarks consist of still images, we attribute the gains mainly to next-crop prediction and the generative decoder, both of which improve ADE20K in our ablations (Table 5 b,c).
sents.zh: 由于这些基准由静态图像组成，我们将这些提升主要归因于 next-crop 预测和生成式解码器，二者在我们的消融实验中都改善了 ADE20K 的结果（表 5b、c）。

sents.en: Figure 4 further shows that VANE produces cleaner and more coherent segments than V-JEPA 2.1.
sents.zh: 图 4 进一步表明，VANE 生成的分割结果比 V-JEPA 2.1 更干净、更连贯。

paragraphs.en: Prediction space and granularity. Replacing pixel targets with frozen DINOv2 ViT-L embeddings improves SSv2 by 16.2 points and ADE20K by 21.0 mIoU (Table 5 a). Among alternative targets, DINOv2 outperforms SigLIP 2 and VA-VAE ( Yao et al., 2025 ) by 6.8 and 4.3 points on SSv2, and the online EMA target by 4.8 points, suggesting that effective targets should capture the content and local structure of a scene while abstracting over appearance variation. We adopt DINOv2 as the default tokenizer because it performs best on IN1K and SSv2, whereas DINOv3 is only slightly better on ADE20K (45.2 vs. 45.1). To isolate the effect of prediction granularity, we also compare next-frame prediction with standard next-token prediction, which predicts each visual token from the preceding tokens (Appendix D.4 ). With the target space fixed, next-frame prediction improves IN1K, SSv2, and ADE20K by 3.7, 19.1, and 22.7 points, respectively, showing that the gains stem from the prediction objective rather than from the target encoder itself.
paragraphs.zh: 预测空间与粒度。 用冻结的 DINOv2 ViT-L 嵌入替换像素目标，使 SSv2 提升 16.2 个百分点，ADE20K 提升 21.0 mIoU（表 5 a）。 在备选目标中，DINOv2 在 SSv2 上分别比 SigLIP 2 和 VA-VAE（Yao et al., 2025）高出 6.8 和 4.3 个百分点，比在线 EMA 目标高出 4.8 个百分点，这表明有效的目标应当捕捉场景的内容与局部结构，同时对外观变化进行抽象。 我们采用 DINOv2 作为默认分词器，因为它在 IN1K 和 SSv2 上表现最佳，而 DINOv3 仅在 ADE20K 上略优（45.2 对 45.1）。 为了分离预测粒度的影响，我们还将逐帧预测与标准的下一词元预测进行了比较，后者根据前序词元预测每个视觉词元（附录 D.4）。 在目标空间固定的情况下，逐帧预测使 IN1K、SSv2 和 ADE20K 分别提升 3.7、19.1 和 22.7 个百分点，表明这些增益源于预测目标本身，而非目标编码器。

paragraphs.en: Unified image prediction. Table 5 b compares three image objectives under the same video objective: masked-image completion, next-cell prediction, and local-to-global next-crop prediction. For next-cell prediction, we uniformly partition an image into a 2 × 2 2\times 2 grid, treat the four cells as an ordered sequence, and predict each cell from the preceding ones; next-crop prediction instead orders views from local to global and supervises only newly revealed regions. Next-crop prediction performs best on all three benchmarks, improving ADE20K by 2.0 and 6.8 mIoU over next-cell prediction and masked-image completion, respectively. Both ordered objectives outperform masked completion, indicating that images benefit from the same predictive structure as videos, and the further gain of next-crop prediction suggests that progressively expanding context is preferable to a fixed grid.
paragraphs.zh: 统一的图像预测。 表 5b 在相同视频目标下比较了三种图像目标：掩码图像补全、下一单元格预测，以及局部到全局的下一裁剪预测。 对于下一单元格预测，我们将图像均匀划分为 2 × 2 2\times 2 网格，把四个单元格视为有序序列，并从先前的单元格预测每一个单元格；下一裁剪预测则将视图按从局部到全局排序，仅监督新揭示的区域。 下一裁剪预测在全部三个基准上表现最佳，相比下一单元格预测和掩码图像补全，在 ADE20K 上分别提升 2.0 和 6.8 mIoU。 两种有序目标均优于掩码补全，表明图像能从与视频相同的预测结构中获益，而下一裁剪预测的进一步增益则说明逐步扩展的上下文优于固定网格。

paragraphs.en: Generative supervision for spatial detail. We test whether the auxiliary generative objective helps preserve spatial information beyond semantic prediction. Adding the generative decoder raises ADE20K from 42.8 to 45.1 mIoU (Table 5 c), with smaller gains of 0.2 points on IN1K and 0.3 on SSv2. The larger gain on dense perception suggests reconstructing visual content in pixel space complements semantic prediction by preserving fine-grained spatial structure.
paragraphs.zh: 面向空间细节的生成式监督。 我们测试辅助生成目标是否有助于在语义预测之外保留空间信息。 添加生成式解码器将 ADE20K 从 42.8 提升到 45.1 mIoU（表 5 c），在 IN1K 和 SSv2 上的增益较小，分别为 0.2 和 0.3 个百分点。 在密集感知任务上更大的增益表明，在像素空间中重建视觉内容通过保留细粒度空间结构来补充语义预测。

paragraphs.en: Scaling and the training recipe. Figure 5 summarizes the cumulative effects of model scaling, data expansion, and post-training. Scaling the encoder from 300M to 1B parameters improves both SSv2 and ADE20K, while data expansion brings further gains. Long-video post-training yields the clearest improvement on SSv2 (73.8 to 75.6), suggesting that longer temporal context strengthens next-frame prediction by exposing the model to richer visual evolution. The final 384 × 384 384\times 384 cooldown further improves SSv2 and ADE20K. Overall, the complete recipe improves SSv2 and ADE20K by 3.6 and 5.9 points, respectively, highlighting complementary benefits from model and data scaling, longer temporal context, and higher spatial resolution.
paragraphs.zh: 扩展规模与训练方案。 图 5 总结了模型扩展、数据扩充与后训练的累积效果。 将编码器从 3 亿参数扩展到 10 亿参数可同时提升 SSv2 和 ADE20K 的表现，而数据扩充带来进一步提升。 长视频后训练在 SSv2 上带来了最明显的提升（73.8 提升至 75.6），这表明更长的时间上下文通过让模型接触更丰富的视觉演变，从而强化了下一帧预测能力。 最终 384 × 384 384\times 384 的学习率冷却阶段进一步提升了 SSv2 和 ADE20K 的表现。 总体而言，完整的训练方案使 SSv2 和 ADE20K 分别提升了 3.6 和 5.9 个百分点，凸显了模型与数据扩展、更长时间上下文以及更高空间分辨率所带来的互补收益。

paragraphs.en: We presented VANE, a self-supervised visual pretraining framework that predicts the next frame in embedding space rather than recovering missing content within an observed context, making temporal evolution the primary learning signal. Extending this objective to images through local-to-global next-crop prediction enables unified image–video pretraining. Across anticipation, global recognition, and dense perception, VANE achieves state-of-the-art performance among unified encoders on most benchmarks and improves consistently with model and data scale, supporting next-frame prediction in embedding space as a scalable principle for visual world modeling that captures both what the visual world contains and how it evolves.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 VANE，一个自监督视觉预训练框架，它在嵌入空间中预测下一帧，而不是在观测上下文内恢复缺失内容，从而使时间演化成为主要的学习信号。 通过局部到全局的下一裁剪块预测将这一目标扩展到图像，可以实现图像–视频的统一预训练。 在预测、全局识别和密集感知任务上，VANE 在统一编码器中于大多数基准上取得了最先进的性能，并且随模型和数据规模的提升而持续改进，这支持了在嵌入空间中进行下一帧预测作为视觉世界建模的可扩展原则，能够同时捕捉视觉世界包含什么以及它如何演化。

paragraphs.en: VANE consists of a shared causal visual encoder, a context-isolated state predictor, a frozen semantic tokenizer, and a lightweight generative decoder. The encoder is the only component retained for downstream evaluation; the state predictor, semantic tokenizer, and generative decoder are used only during pretraining.

sents.zh: 编码器是唯一保留用于下游评估的组件；状态预测器、语义分词器和生成解码器仅在预训练期间使用。

paragraphs.en: Table 6 summarizes the model configurations. Unless otherwise specified, the predictor uses the same depth and hidden dimension across encoder scales.
paragraphs.zh: 表 6 总结了模型配置。 除非另有说明，预测器在编码器的各个尺度上使用相同的深度和隐藏维度。

sents.en: Table 6 summarizes the model configurations.
sents.zh: 表 6 总结了模型配置。

sents.en: Unless otherwise specified, the predictor uses the same depth and hidden dimension across encoder scales.
sents.zh: 除非另有说明，预测器在编码器的各个尺度上使用相同的深度和隐藏维度。

paragraphs.en: Causal encoder. The encoder processes all observations in a sequence in a single forward pass. Under frame-causal attention, tokens in observation t t may attend to tokens from observations 1 , … , t 1,\ldots,t , but never to future observations. Tokens within the same observation are processed jointly. For videos, the input is patchified into 2 × 16 × 16 2\times 16\times 16 temporal-spatial tubelets ( T × H × W T\times H\times W ), such that each temporal encoder position spans two consecutive sampled raw frames. For images, each local-to-global crop constitutes one observation. Images and videos use separate patch embeddings and a learned modality embedding, while all other components are shared; image sequences use no context masking. Fig. 6 (left) illustrates the attention mask.
paragraphs.zh: 因果编码器。 该编码器在单次前向传播中处理序列中的所有观测。 在帧因果注意力下，观测 t 中的词元可以关注来自观测 1,…,t 的词元，但永远不会关注未来的观测。 同一观测内的词元被联合处理。 对于视频，输入被分块为 2×16×16 的时空小块（T×H×W），使得每个时间编码器位置跨越两个连续采样的原始帧。 对于图像，每个局部到全局裁剪构成一个观测。 图像和视频使用各自独立的分块嵌入和一个可学习的模态嵌入，而所有其他组件是共享的；图像序列不使用上下文掩码。 图 6（左）展示了该注意力掩码。

sents.en: Causal encoder.
sents.zh: 因果编码器。

sents.en: The encoder processes all observations in a sequence in a single forward pass.
sents.zh: 该编码器在单次前向传播中处理序列中的所有观测。

sents.en: Tokens within the same observation are processed jointly.
sents.zh: 同一观测内的词元被联合处理。

sents.en: For videos, the input is patchified into 2 × 16 × 16 2\times 16\times 16 temporal-spatial tubelets ( T × H × W T\times H\times W ), such that each temporal encoder position spans two consecutive sampled raw frames.
sents.zh: 对于视频，输入被分块为 2×16×16 的时空小块（T×H×W），使得每个时间编码器位置跨越两个连续采样的原始帧。

sents.en: For images, each local-to-global crop constitutes one observation.
sents.zh: 对于图像，每个局部到全局裁剪构成一个观测。

paragraphs.en: Context-isolated state predictor. The state predictor receives encoded historical states as read-only context. Since the encoder and predictor use different hidden dimensions, encoder states are first projected from the encoder width to the 384-dimensional predictor space. Historical context states then provide keys and values but are never updated inside the predictor. Prediction tokens are obtained by duplicating a learned token and assigning the corresponding target patch positions.
paragraphs.zh: 上下文隔离的状态预测器。 状态预测器接收编码后的历史状态作为只读上下文。 由于编码器和预测器使用不同的隐藏维度，编码器状态首先从编码器宽度投影到384维的预测器空间。 历史上下文状态随后提供键和值，但在预测器内部从不被更新。 预测词元通过复制一个可学习的词元并分配相应的目标补丁位置来获得。

sents.en: Context-isolated state predictor.
sents.zh: 上下文隔离的状态预测器。

sents.en: The state predictor receives encoded historical states as read-only context.
sents.zh: 状态预测器接收编码后的历史状态作为只读上下文。

sents.en: Since the encoder and predictor use different hidden dimensions, encoder states are first projected from the encoder width to the 384-dimensional predictor space.
sents.zh: 由于编码器和预测器使用不同的隐藏维度，编码器状态首先从编码器宽度投影到384维的预测器空间。

sents.en: Historical context states then provide keys and values but are never updated inside the predictor.
sents.zh: 历史上下文状态随后提供键和值，但在预测器内部从不被更新。

sents.en: Prediction tokens are obtained by duplicating a learned token and assigning the corresponding target patch positions.
sents.zh: 预测词元通过复制一个可学习的词元并分配相应的目标补丁位置来获得。

paragraphs.en: Prediction tokens for observation t + 1 t+1 attend to the context states of observations 1 , … , t 1,\ldots,t and to one another, while predictions belonging to different future observations remain isolated (Fig. 6 , right). The resulting predictor states are projected back to the encoder width before being passed to the semantic and generative objectives. This design separates representation learning from future-state readout: the predictor can only use information already encoded by the causal backbone.
paragraphs.zh: 针对观测 t + 1 t+1 的预测 token 会关注观测 1 , … , t 1,\ldots,t 的上下文状态并彼此关注，而属于不同未来观测的预测之间保持隔离（图 6，右）。 得到的预测器状态会被投影回编码器宽度，然后再传入语义目标和生成目标。 这种设计将表示学习与未来状态读取分离开来：预测器只能使用因果主干已经编码的信息。

sents.en: Prediction tokens for observation t + 1 t+1 attend to the context states of observations 1 , … , t 1,\ldots,t and to one another, while predictions belonging to different future observations remain isolated (Fig. 6 , right).
sents.zh: 针对观测 t + 1 t+1 的预测 token 会关注观测 1 , … , t 1,\ldots,t 的上下文状态并彼此关注，而属于不同未来观测的预测之间保持隔离（图 6，右）。

sents.en: The resulting predictor states are projected back to the encoder width before being passed to the semantic and generative objectives.
sents.zh: 得到的预测器状态会被投影回编码器宽度，然后再传入语义目标和生成目标。

sents.en: This design separates representation learning from future-state readout: the predictor can only use information already encoded by the causal backbone.
sents.zh: 这种设计将表示学习与未来状态读取分离开来：预测器只能使用因果主干已经编码的信息。

paragraphs.en: Semantic tokenizer. We use a frozen DINOv2 ViT-L as the semantic tokenizer for the main model. We take its final patch tokens after removing special tokens and normalize each patch feature with a LayerNorm without affine parameters; no additional ℓ 2 \ell_{2} normalization is applied.
paragraphs.zh: 语义分词器。 我们使用冻结的 DINOv2 ViT-L 作为主模型的语义分词器。 我们取其移除特殊标记后的最终 patch token，并用不带仿射参数的 LayerNorm 对每个 patch 特征进行归一化；不再施加额外的 ℓ 2 \ell_{2} 归一化。

sents.en: Semantic tokenizer.
sents.zh: 语义分词器。

sents.en: We use a frozen DINOv2 ViT-L as the semantic tokenizer for the main model.
sents.zh: 我们使用冻结的 DINOv2 ViT-L 作为主模型的语义分词器。

sents.en: We take its final patch tokens after removing special tokens and normalize each patch feature with a LayerNorm without affine parameters; no additional ℓ 2 \ell_{2} normalization is applied.
sents.zh: 我们取其移除特殊标记后的最终 patch token，并用不带仿射参数的 LayerNorm 对每个 patch 特征进行归一化；不再施加额外的 ℓ 2 \ell_{2} 归一化。

paragraphs.en: To align tokenizer targets with the encoder patch grid, we resize the tokenizer input so that its 14 × 14 14\times 14 patchification produces the same H p × W p H_{p}\times W_{p} spatial grid, without interpolating tokenizer features. For example, a 256 × 256 256\times 256 encoder input produces a 16 × 16 16\times 16 grid, while the corresponding tokenizer input is resized to 224 × 224 224\times 224 .
paragraphs.zh: 为了使分词器的目标与编码器的图像块网格对齐，我们对分词器的输入进行缩放，使其 14 × 14 14\times 14 的分块处理产生与编码器相同的 H p × W p H_{p}\times W_{p} 空间网格，而不对分词器特征进行插值。 例如，256 × 256 256\times 256 的编码器输入会产生 16 × 16 16\times 16 的网格，而对应的分词器输入则被缩放至 224 × 224 224\times 224。

sents.en: To align tokenizer targets with the encoder patch grid, we resize the tokenizer input so that its 14 × 14 14\times 14 patchification produces the same H p × W p H_{p}\times W_{p} spatial grid, without interpolating tokenizer features.
sents.zh: 为了使分词器的目标与编码器的图像块网格对齐，我们对分词器的输入进行缩放，使其 14 × 14 14\times 14 的分块处理产生与编码器相同的 H p × W p H_{p}\times W_{p} 空间网格，而不对分词器特征进行插值。

sents.en: For example, a 256 × 256 256\times 256 encoder input produces a 16 × 16 16\times 16 grid, while the corresponding tokenizer input is resized to 224 × 224 224\times 224 .
sents.zh: 例如，256 × 256 256\times 256 的编码器输入会产生 16 × 16 16\times 16 的网格，而对应的分词器输入则被缩放至 224 × 224 224\times 224。

paragraphs.en: For images, the tokenizer encodes the full image once, and crop targets are indexed from the aligned full-image grid at their corresponding patch positions. For videos, it encodes individual frames independently. Each normalized patch feature is 1024-dimensional; features at the same spatial position in a two-frame video tubelet are concatenated into a 2048-dimensional target, while image features are duplicated to the same dimension. Both modalities therefore share the same semantic projection head, which maps the predictor output to the 2048-dimensional tokenizer target space.
paragraphs.zh: 对于图像，分词器对完整图像编码一次，裁剪目标从对齐的整图网格中按其对应的图块位置进行索引。 对于视频，它对各帧独立进行编码。 每个归一化后的图块特征是 1024 维的；在两帧视频管段（tubelet）中相同空间位置的特征被拼接成 2048 维的目标，而图像特征则被复制到相同维度。 因此两种模态共享同一个语义投影头，该投影头将预测器的输出映射到 2048 维的分词器目标空间。

sents.en: For images, the tokenizer encodes the full image once, and crop targets are indexed from the aligned full-image grid at their corresponding patch positions.
sents.zh: 对于图像，分词器对完整图像编码一次，裁剪目标从对齐的整图网格中按其对应的图块位置进行索引。

sents.en: For videos, it encodes individual frames independently.
sents.zh: 对于视频，它对各帧独立进行编码。

sents.en: Each normalized patch feature is 1024-dimensional; features at the same spatial position in a two-frame video tubelet are concatenated into a 2048-dimensional target, while image features are duplicated to the same dimension.
sents.zh: 每个归一化后的图块特征是 1024 维的；在两帧视频管段（tubelet）中相同空间位置的特征被拼接成 2048 维的目标，而图像特征则被复制到相同维度。

sents.en: Both modalities therefore share the same semantic projection head, which maps the predictor output to the 2048-dimensional tokenizer target space.
sents.zh: 因此两种模态共享同一个语义投影头，该投影头将预测器的输出映射到 2048 维的分词器目标空间。

paragraphs.en: Patch-isolated generative decoder. The auxiliary generative decoder is implemented as a six-layer DiffMLP with hidden dimension 1536. To share the same decoder across modalities, each image is duplicated along the temporal dimension before pixel patchification, forming a two-frame input with identical image content. Consequently, both image patches and video tubelets are represented by 2 × 3 × 16 × 16 = 1536 2\times 3\times 16\times 16=1536 pixel values.
paragraphs.zh: 补丁隔离的生成式解码器。 辅助生成式解码器实现为一个隐藏维度为 1536 的六层 DiffMLP。 为了在不同模态间共享同一个解码器，每张图像在进行像素补丁化之前沿时间维度复制，形成包含相同图像内容的两帧输入。 因此，图像补丁和视频管（tubelet）都由 2 × 3 × 16 × 16 = 1536 2\times 3\times 16\times 16=1536 个像素值表示。

sents.en: Patch-isolated generative decoder.
sents.zh: 补丁隔离的生成式解码器。

sents.en: The auxiliary generative decoder is implemented as a six-layer DiffMLP with hidden dimension 1536.
sents.zh: 辅助生成式解码器实现为一个隐藏维度为 1536 的六层 DiffMLP。

sents.en: To share the same decoder across modalities, each image is duplicated along the temporal dimension before pixel patchification, forming a two-frame input with identical image content.
sents.zh: 为了在不同模态间共享同一个解码器，每张图像在进行像素补丁化之前沿时间维度复制，形成包含相同图像内容的两帧输入。

sents.en: Consequently, both image patches and video tubelets are represented by 2 × 3 × 16 × 16 = 1536 2\times 3\times 16\times 16=1536 pixel values.
sents.zh: 因此，图像补丁和视频管（tubelet）都由 2 × 3 × 16 × 16 = 1536 2\times 3\times 16\times 16=1536 个像素值表示。

paragraphs.en: For the main ViT-g model, the 1408-dimensional predicted state is concatenated with the 1536-dimensional noisy pixel token and projected from 2944 to the 1536-dimensional decoder space. Flow time is encoded using a 256-dimensional sinusoidal embedding followed by a 256 → 1536 → 1536 256\rightarrow 1536\rightarrow 1536 SiLU MLP. Each DiffMLP block contains LayerNorm, an MLP, SiLU activations, and adaptive shift, scale, and gate modulation. The final layer predicts a 1536-dimensional flow velocity. Target patches are decoded independently, without access to neighboring target patches or encoder context other than through the predicted state.
paragraphs.zh: 对于主 ViT-g 模型，将 1408 维的预测状态与 1536 维的含噪像素 token 拼接，并从 2944 维投影到 1536 维的解码器空间。 流时间使用 256 维正弦嵌入进行编码，随后经过一个 256 → 1536 → 1536 256\rightarrow 1536\rightarrow 1536 的 SiLU 多层感知机。 每个 DiffMLP 块包含 LayerNorm、一个多层感知机、SiLU 激活，以及自适应的平移、缩放和门控调制。 最后一层预测 1536 维的流速度。 目标 patch 被独立解码，除了通过预测状态之外，无法访问相邻的目标 patch 或编码器上下文。

sents.en: For the main ViT-g model, the 1408-dimensional predicted state is concatenated with the 1536-dimensional noisy pixel token and projected from 2944 to the 1536-dimensional decoder space.
sents.zh: 对于主 ViT-g 模型，将 1408 维的预测状态与 1536 维的含噪像素 token 拼接，并从 2944 维投影到 1536 维的解码器空间。

sents.en: Flow time is encoded using a 256-dimensional sinusoidal embedding followed by a 256 → 1536 → 1536 256\rightarrow 1536\rightarrow 1536 SiLU MLP.
sents.zh: 流时间使用 256 维正弦嵌入进行编码，随后经过一个 256 → 1536 → 1536 256\rightarrow 1536\rightarrow 1536 的 SiLU 多层感知机。

sents.en: Each DiffMLP block contains LayerNorm, an MLP, SiLU activations, and adaptive shift, scale, and gate modulation.
sents.zh: 每个 DiffMLP 块包含 LayerNorm、一个多层感知机、SiLU 激活，以及自适应的平移、缩放和门控调制。

sents.en: The final layer predicts a 1536-dimensional flow velocity.
sents.zh: 最后一层预测 1536 维的流速度。

sents.en: Target patches are decoded independently, without access to neighboring target patches or encoder context other than through the predicted state.
sents.zh: 目标 patch 被独立解码，除了通过预测状态之外，无法访问相邻的目标 patch 或编码器上下文。

paragraphs.en: Our training recipe contains four consecutive stages (Table 7 ): (1) learning-rate warm-up, (2) large-scale base pretraining, (3) long-video post-training, and (4) high-resolution cooldown. The first two stages learn the main representation using 16-frame clips at 256 × 256 256\times 256 resolution, while the last two stages progressively increase temporal and spatial context.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的训练方案包含四个连续阶段（表 7）：(1) 学习率预热，(2) 大规模基础预训练，(3) 长视频后训练，以及 (4) 高分辨率冷却。 前两个阶段使用 256 × 256 256\times 256 分辨率的 16 帧片段学习主要表征，而后两个阶段则逐步增加时间与空间上下文。

sents.en: Our training recipe contains four consecutive stages (Table 7 ): (1) learning-rate warm-up, (2) large-scale base pretraining, (3) long-video post-training, and (4) high-resolution cooldown.
sents.zh: 我们的训练方案包含四个连续阶段（表 7）：(1) 学习率预热，(2) 大规模基础预训练，(3) 长视频后训练，以及 (4) 高分辨率冷却。

sents.en: The first two stages learn the main representation using 16-frame clips at 256 × 256 256\times 256 resolution, while the last two stages progressively increase temporal and spatial context.
sents.zh: 前两个阶段使用 256 × 256 256\times 256 分辨率的 16 帧片段学习主要表征，而后两个阶段则逐步增加时间与空间上下文。

paragraphs.en: Video sampling. Videos are sampled at a target rate of 4 FPS. Base pretraining uses 16-frame clips and long-video post-training increases the observation window to 64 frames. The encoder uses a temporal tubelet size of two, so each temporal patch corresponds to two consecutive sampled frames. For videos longer than the required observation window, a clip window is randomly selected during training.
paragraphs.zh: 视频采样。 视频以每秒 4 帧（4 FPS）的目标速率进行采样。 基础预训练使用 16 帧的视频片段，而长视频后训练将观察窗口扩大到 64 帧。 编码器使用的时间 tubelet 大小为 2，因此每个时间块对应两帧连续的采样帧。 对于超过所需观察窗口长度的视频，训练时会随机选取一个片段窗口。

sents.en: Video sampling.
sents.zh: 视频采样。

sents.en: Videos are sampled at a target rate of 4 FPS.
sents.zh: 视频以每秒 4 帧（4 FPS）的目标速率进行采样。

sents.en: Base pretraining uses 16-frame clips and long-video post-training increases the observation window to 64 frames.
sents.zh: 基础预训练使用 16 帧的视频片段，而长视频后训练将观察窗口扩大到 64 帧。

sents.en: The encoder uses a temporal tubelet size of two, so each temporal patch corresponds to two consecutive sampled frames.
sents.zh: 编码器使用的时间 tubelet 大小为 2，因此每个时间块对应两帧连续的采样帧。

sents.en: For videos longer than the required observation window, a clip window is randomly selected during training.
sents.zh: 对于超过所需观察窗口长度的视频，训练时会随机选取一个片段窗口。

paragraphs.en: Image and video augmentation. At 256 × 256 256\times 256 resolution, both image and video inputs use random resized cropping with an area range of [ 0.3 , 1.0 ] [0.3,1.0] and aspect-ratio range of [ 0.75 , 1.35 ] [0.75,1.35] , followed by horizontal flipping with probability 0.5. We do not use AutoAugment, random erasing, or additional color jitter in this training configuration. The same spatial augmentation principle is retained when increasing the input resolution during high-resolution cooldown.
paragraphs.zh: 图像与视频数据增强。 在 256 × 256 256\times 256 分辨率下，图像和视频输入均采用随机裁剪缩放，面积范围为 [ 0.3 , 1.0 ] [0.3,1.0]，宽高比范围为 [ 0.75 , 1.35 ] [0.75,1.35]，随后以 0.5 的概率进行水平翻转。 在此训练配置中，我们不使用 AutoAugment、随机擦除或额外的颜色抖动。 在高分辨率冷却阶段提高输入分辨率时，仍保留相同的空间增强原则。

sents.en: Image and video augmentation.
sents.zh: 图像与视频数据增强。

sents.en: At 256 × 256 256\times 256 resolution, both image and video inputs use random resized cropping with an area range of [ 0.3 , 1.0 ] [0.3,1.0] and aspect-ratio range of [ 0.75 , 1.35 ] [0.75,1.35] , followed by horizontal flipping with probability 0.5.
sents.zh: 在 256 × 256 256\times 256 分辨率下，图像和视频输入均采用随机裁剪缩放，面积范围为 [ 0.3 , 1.0 ] [0.3,1.0]，宽高比范围为 [ 0.75 , 1.35 ] [0.75,1.35]，随后以 0.5 的概率进行水平翻转。

sents.en: We do not use AutoAugment, random erasing, or additional color jitter in this training configuration.
sents.zh: 在此训练配置中，我们不使用 AutoAugment、随机擦除或额外的颜色抖动。

sents.en: The same spatial augmentation principle is retained when increasing the input resolution during high-resolution cooldown.
sents.zh: 在高分辨率冷却阶段提高输入分辨率时，仍保留相同的空间增强原则。

paragraphs.en: We first apply the image augmentation described in Appendix B.1 to obtain a base image. Local-to-global views are then sampled from its patch grid without resizing the individual crops. All view coordinates and semantic targets are defined relative to this shared base image.
paragraphs.zh: 我们首先应用附录 B.1 中描述的图像增强来获得基础图像。 然后从其补丁网格中采样局部到全局视图，而不对单个裁剪块进行缩放。 所有视图坐标和语义目标均相对于该共享基础图像定义。

sents.en: We first apply the image augmentation described in Appendix B.1 to obtain a base image.
sents.zh: 我们首先应用附录 B.1 中描述的图像增强来获得基础图像。

sents.en: Local-to-global views are then sampled from its patch grid without resizing the individual crops.
sents.zh: 然后从其补丁网格中采样局部到全局视图，而不对单个裁剪块进行缩放。

sents.en: All view coordinates and semantic targets are defined relative to this shared base image.
sents.zh: 所有视图坐标和语义目标均相对于该共享基础图像定义。

paragraphs.en: For image pretraining, we construct an ordered sequence of K = 3 K=3 local-to-global crops. Two local crops are sampled with area ratios in [ 0.2 , 0.6 ] [0.2,0.6] , followed by a global crop sampled with an area ratio in [ 0.8 , 1.0 ] [0.8,1.0] . All crops use aspect ratios in [ 0.75 , 1.35 ] [0.75,1.35] and are sampled on the image patch grid.
paragraphs.zh: 对于图像预训练，我们构建了一个由 K=3 个从局部到全局裁剪组成的有序序列。 先以 [0.2, 0.6] 的面积比例采样两个局部裁剪，随后以 [0.8, 1.0] 的面积比例采样一个全局裁剪。 所有裁剪均使用 [0.75, 1.35] 的长宽比，并在图像块网格上进行采样。

paragraphs.en: The two local crops are ordered by area. Successive crops cover increasingly broad and complementary scene regions, and may partially overlap or extend to adjacent regions. To encourage complementary observations, local-crop sampling favors pairs whose intersection occupies at most 0.4 of the larger local crop. The final global crop provides substantially broader scene context but is not required to coincide exactly with the full uncropped image. Semantic and generative supervision are applied only to patch positions newly revealed relative to preceding observations.
paragraphs.zh: 两个局部裁剪区域按面积排序。 相邻的裁剪区域覆盖越来越广且互补的场景区域，并且可能部分重叠或延伸到相邻区域。 为鼓励互补的观察，局部裁剪的采样倾向于选择交集至多占较大局部裁剪区域 0.4 的裁剪对。 最终的全局裁剪区域提供了明显更广的场景上下文，但不必与未裁剪的完整图像完全重合。 语义监督和生成监督仅应用于相对于先前观察新显露的图像块位置。

paragraphs.en: To increase the difficulty of next-frame prediction, we apply random multi-block tube masking to the historical video context while keeping future targets fully supervised, following V-JEPA 2.1 ( Mur-Labadia et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 为了提高下一帧预测的难度，我们对历史视频上下文应用随机多块管状掩码，同时保持未来目标完全受监督，遵循 V-JEPA 2.1（Mur-Labadia et al., 2026）的方法。

paragraphs.en: We follow the two multi-block mask configurations used in V-JEPA 2.1. One samples eight spatial blocks with scale 0.15 while retaining at least 5% of tokens; the other samples two larger blocks with spatial scale 0.70. For both configurations, the temporal scale is 1.0 and the block aspect ratio is sampled from [ 0.75 , 1.5 ] [0.75,1.5] . Block positions are sampled randomly and may overlap, so the resulting fraction of masked context tokens varies across samples rather than being defined by a single fixed mask ratio. The spatial masking pattern is extended temporally to form tube masks across the observed clip.
paragraphs.zh: 我们沿用 V-JEPA 2.1 中使用的两种多块掩码配置。 一种配置采样八个空间块，缩放比例为 0.15，同时保留至少 5% 的词元；另一种配置采样两个更大的空间块，空间缩放比例为 0.70。 对于这两种配置，时间缩放比例均为 1.0，且块的长宽比从 [0.75, 1.5] 中采样。 块的位置是随机采样的，并且可能相互重叠，因此被掩码的上下文词元比例在不同样本之间会有所变化，而不是由单一的固定掩码率所决定。 空间掩码模式在时间维度上被扩展，从而在观测到的片段中形成管状掩码。

paragraphs.en: Training starts from randomly initialized VANE parameters while the semantic tokenizer remains frozen. During the first 12K updates, the learning rate is linearly increased from 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} to 6 × 10 − 4 6\times 10^{-4} . We use 16-frame video clips and 256 × 256 256\times 256 inputs, with global batch sizes of 1536 videos and 4608 images. The warm-up stabilizes optimization before large-scale joint image–video pretraining.
paragraphs.zh: 训练从随机初始化的 VANE 参数开始，同时语义分词器保持冻结。 在前 12K 次更新中，学习率从 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} 线性增加到 6 × 10 − 4 6\times 10^{-4}。 我们使用 16 帧的视频片段和 256 × 256 256\times 256 的输入，全局批量大小为 1536 个视频和 4608 张图像。 预热在大规模图像-视频联合预训练之前稳定了优化过程。

paragraphs.en: After warm-up, we continue training for 180K updates using the same 16-frame, 256 × 256 256\times 256 input configuration and a constant learning rate of 6 × 10 − 4 6\times 10^{-4} . This stage constitutes the main representation-learning phase and uses the complete data mixture described in Appendix .

paragraphs.en: Image and video batches are processed independently in separate forward/backward passes. Their gradients are accumulated before one optimizer step, allowing the shared encoder and predictor to learn from both modalities without requiring image and video samples to be packed into the same sequence.
paragraphs.zh: 图像和视频批次在各自独立的前向/反向传播中处理。 它们的梯度在进行一次优化器步骤之前被累积，使共享编码器和预测器能够从两种模态中学习，而无需将图像和视频样本打包到同一序列中。

paragraphs.en: The main paper studies prediction targets, image prediction strategies, generative supervision, scaling, and the training schedule. Here we first provide a controlled comparison with V-JEPA 2.1 under matched pretraining conditions, followed by further analyses of image crops, state-predictor attention, and prediction granularity. Unless otherwise specified, all ablations use a ViT-L encoder trained for 50K iterations.
paragraphs.zh: 主论文研究了预测目标、图像预测策略、生成式监督、扩展性以及训练日程。 在此，我们首先在匹配的预训练条件下提供与 V-JEPA 2.1 的受控对比，随后进一步分析图像裁剪、状态预测器注意力以及预测粒度。 除非另有说明，所有消融实验均使用训练 50K 次迭代的 ViT-L 编码器。

sents.zh: 主论文研究了预测目标、图像预测策略、生成式监督、扩展性以及训练日程。

sents.en: Here we first provide a controlled comparison with V-JEPA 2.1 under matched pretraining conditions, followed by further analyses of image crops, state-predictor attention, and prediction granularity.

paragraphs.en: We perform a controlled comparison with V-JEPA 2.1 ( Mur-Labadia et al., 2026 ) to examine whether the gains of VANE persist after accounting for differences in pretraining data and prediction targets. All models use ViT-L encoders trained on VISTA (Appendix ) for 50K iterations under the same training budget. V-JEPA 2.1 retains its bidirectional masked feature-prediction formulation, whereas VANE uses next-frame prediction. We evaluate frozen encoder features using the same downstream protocols as in the main paper, and report top-1 accuracy on IN1K and SSv2 and mIoU on ADE20K.
paragraphs.zh: 我们与 V-JEPA 2.1（Mur-Labadia et al., 2026）进行了受控对比，以检验在考虑预训练数据和预测目标差异后，VANE 的增益是否仍然存在。 所有模型均使用在 VISTA（附录）上训练的 ViT-L 编码器，在相同的训练预算下训练 50K 次迭代。 V-JEPA 2.1 保留了其双向掩码特征预测的构造方式，而 VANE 则采用下一帧预测。 我们使用与主论文相同的下游协议评估冻结编码器特征，并报告在 IN1K 和 SSv2 上的 top-1 准确率以及在 ADE20K 上的 mIoU。

sents.en: We perform a controlled comparison with V-JEPA 2.1 ( Mur-Labadia et al., 2026 ) to examine whether the gains of VANE persist after accounting for differences in pretraining data and prediction targets.
sents.zh: 我们与 V-JEPA 2.1（Mur-Labadia et al., 2026）进行了受控对比，以检验在考虑预训练数据和预测目标差异后，VANE 的增益是否仍然存在。

sents.en: All models use ViT-L encoders trained on VISTA (Appendix ) for 50K iterations under the same training budget.
sents.zh: 所有模型均使用在 VISTA（附录）上训练的 ViT-L 编码器，在相同的训练预算下训练 50K 次迭代。

sents.zh: V-JEPA 2.1 保留了其双向掩码特征预测的构造方式，而 VANE 则采用下一帧预测。

sents.en: We evaluate frozen encoder features using the same downstream protocols as in the main paper, and report top-1 accuracy on IN1K and SSv2 and mIoU on ADE20K.
sents.zh: 我们使用与主论文相同的下游协议评估冻结编码器特征，并报告在 IN1K 和 SSv2 上的 top-1 准确率以及在 ADE20K 上的 mIoU。

paragraphs.en: Matching the pretraining data. We first compare VANE with the standard V-JEPA 2.1 formulation while matching the pretraining corpus, encoder scale, and iteration budget. As shown in Table 8 , VANE improves IN1K accuracy by 2.7 points and ADE20K by 6.7 mIoU, while achieving slightly higher SSv2 accuracy (72.3% vs. 72.0%). Thus, the performance differences persist when both methods are trained on the same data at the same model scale and training budget.

This variant retains V-JEPA 2.1’s bidirectional masked feature-prediction objective while predicting targets in the same semantic embedding space as VANE.

paragraphs.en: The frozen DINOv2 target improves the masked baseline on IN1K and ADE20K, from 81.8 to 82.7 and from 38.4 to 41.5, respectively, while SSv2 decreases from 72.0 to 70.6. With both the pretraining corpus and semantic target matched, VANE retains gains of 1.8 points on IN1K, 1.7 points on SSv2, and 3.6 mIoU on ADE20K. Thus, neither the pretraining corpus nor the frozen DINOv2 target alone explains the performance gap between masked and next-frame pretraining.
paragraphs.zh: 冻结的 DINOv2 目标在 IN1K 和 ADE20K 上提升了掩码基线的性能，分别从 81.8 提升到 82.7 和从 38.4 提升到 41.5，而 SSv2 则从 72.0 下降到 70.6。 在预训练语料和语义目标都匹配的情况下，VANE 仍在 IN1K 上保持 1.8 个点、在 SSv2 上保持 1.7 个点、在 ADE20K 上保持 3.6 mIoU 的提升。 因此，无论是预训练语料还是冻结的 DINOv2 目标，都不能单独解释掩码预训练与下一帧预训练之间的性能差距。

We additionally vary the number of crops to examine how the amount of intermediate visual context affects representation learning. For all settings, crops are ordered from local to global, and supervision is restricted to regions newly revealed by the next crop. The video objective, semantic tokenizer, model architecture, and training schedule are kept fixed.

paragraphs.en: We next study how the state predictor should interact with historical encoder states. Our default predictor uses context-isolated cross-attention , where encoded historical states are treated as read-only context and provide keys and values to the predictor. Prediction tokens are updated by attending to this historical context to produce the future visual state, while the encoded context itself is not jointly updated inside the predictor.
paragraphs.zh: 接下来我们研究状态预测器应如何与历史编码器状态进行交互。 我们的默认预测器采用上下文隔离的交叉注意力，其中编码后的历史状态被视为只读上下文，为预测器提供键和值。 预测令牌通过关注该历史上下文进行更新，以生成未来的视觉状态，而编码后的上下文本身在预测器内部不会被联合更新。

sents.en: We next study how the state predictor should interact with historical encoder states.
sents.zh: 接下来我们研究状态预测器应如何与历史编码器状态进行交互。

sents.en: Our default predictor uses context-isolated cross-attention , where encoded historical states are treated as read-only context and provide keys and values to the predictor.
sents.zh: 我们的默认预测器采用上下文隔离的交叉注意力，其中编码后的历史状态被视为只读上下文，为预测器提供键和值。

sents.en: Prediction tokens are updated by attending to this historical context to produce the future visual state, while the encoded context itself is not jointly updated inside the predictor.
sents.zh: 预测令牌通过关注该历史上下文进行更新，以生成未来的视觉状态，而编码后的上下文本身在预测器内部不会被联合更新。

paragraphs.en: As a control, we replace context-isolated attention with causal self-attention that jointly updates historical states and prediction tokens. Both variants enforce the same causal boundary: the prediction for observation t t depends only on observations preceding t t , and prediction-token groups remain isolated across target observations. The predictor depth, hidden dimension, target positions, and training objective are otherwise unchanged.
paragraphs.zh: 作为对照，我们将上下文隔离的注意力替换为联合更新历史状态与预测token的因果自注意力。 两种变体都强制执行相同的因果边界：对观测 t t 的预测仅依赖于 t t 之前的观测，并且预测token组在不同的目标观测之间保持隔离。 除此之外，预测器深度、隐藏维度、目标位置和训练目标均保持不变。

sents.en: As a control, we replace context-isolated attention with causal self-attention that jointly updates historical states and prediction tokens.
sents.zh: 作为对照，我们将上下文隔离的注意力替换为联合更新历史状态与预测token的因果自注意力。

sents.en: Both variants enforce the same causal boundary: the prediction for observation t t depends only on observations preceding t t , and prediction-token groups remain isolated across target observations.
sents.zh: 两种变体都强制执行相同的因果边界：对观测 t t 的预测仅依赖于 t t 之前的观测，并且预测token组在不同的目标观测之间保持隔离。

sents.en: The predictor depth, hidden dimension, target positions, and training objective are otherwise unchanged.
sents.zh: 除此之外，预测器深度、隐藏维度、目标位置和训练目标均保持不变。

paragraphs.en: Table 10 shows that context-isolated prediction consistently improves downstream representation quality. Compared with causal self-attention, it improves IN1K accuracy by 3.3 points and SSv2 accuracy by 5.5 points, with a larger gain of 9.6 mIoU on ADE20K.
paragraphs.zh: 表10表明，上下文隔离预测始终能提升下游表征质量。 与因果自注意力相比，它将IN1K准确率提升了3.3个百分点，将SSv2准确率提升了5.5个百分点，并在ADE20K上带来了9.6 mIoU的更大增益。

sents.en: Table 10 shows that context-isolated prediction consistently improves downstream representation quality.
sents.zh: 表10表明，上下文隔离预测始终能提升下游表征质量。

sents.en: Compared with causal self-attention, it improves IN1K accuracy by 3.3 points and SSv2 accuracy by 5.5 points, with a larger gain of 9.6 mIoU on ADE20K.
sents.zh: 与因果自注意力相比，它将IN1K准确率提升了3.3个百分点，将SSv2准确率提升了5.5个百分点，并在ADE20K上带来了9.6 mIoU的更大增益。

paragraphs.en: These results favor a separation between history encoding and future-state prediction. Causal self-attention allows the predictor to further transform historical states before producing the target representation. Context isolation instead requires the encoder outputs to carry the historical information needed for prediction, leaving the predictor to read these states and construct the future representation. This division of roles improves frozen-feature transfer in our experiments, particularly for dense perception.
paragraphs.zh: 这些结果支持将历史编码与未来状态预测分开处理。 因果自注意力使预测器能够在生成目标表示之前进一步变换历史状态。 上下文隔离则要求编码器输出携带预测所需的历史信息，预测器只需读取这些状态并构建未来表示。 在我们的实验中，这种角色分工改善了冻结特征的迁移效果，尤其是在密集感知任务上。

sents.en: These results favor a separation between history encoding and future-state prediction.
sents.zh: 这些结果支持将历史编码与未来状态预测分开处理。

sents.en: Causal self-attention allows the predictor to further transform historical states before producing the target representation.
sents.zh: 因果自注意力使预测器能够在生成目标表示之前进一步变换历史状态。

sents.en: Context isolation instead requires the encoder outputs to carry the historical information needed for prediction, leaving the predictor to read these states and construct the future representation.
sents.zh: 上下文隔离则要求编码器输出携带预测所需的历史信息，预测器只需读取这些状态并构建未来表示。

sents.en: This division of roles improves frozen-feature transfer in our experiments, particularly for dense perception.
sents.zh: 在我们的实验中，这种角色分工改善了冻结特征的迁移效果，尤其是在密集感知任务上。

We compare our next-frame objective with standard next-token prediction (NTP), while keeping the frozen DINOv2 ViT-L semantic target, encoder scale, training schedule, batch size, input resolution, and clip length fixed.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提供了表 5 中用于预测粒度比较的下一词元基线的实现细节。 我们将下一帧目标与标准的下一词元预测（NTP）进行比较，同时保持冻结的 DINOv2 ViT-L 语义目标、编码器规模、训练计划、批次大小、输入分辨率和片段长度不变。

sents.en: We provide implementation details for the next-token baseline used in the prediction-granularity comparison in Table 5 .
sents.zh: 我们提供了表 5 中用于预测粒度比较的下一词元基线的实现细节。

sents.en: We compare our next-frame objective with standard next-token prediction (NTP), while keeping the frozen DINOv2 ViT-L semantic target, encoder scale, training schedule, batch size, input resolution, and clip length fixed.
sents.zh: 我们将下一帧目标与标准的下一词元预测（NTP）进行比较，同时保持冻结的 DINOv2 ViT-L 语义目标、编码器规模、训练计划、批次大小、输入分辨率和片段长度不变。

paragraphs.en: In standard NTP, visual patches are ordered first temporally and then spatially. When predicting the k k -th token of frame t t , the model observes all preceding frames and the first k − 1 k-1 tokens of the current frame, but not later tokens. The encoder therefore follows token-causal attention, analogous to a conventional autoregressive Transformer.
paragraphs.zh: 在标准 NTP 中，视觉块先按时间顺序排列，再按空间顺序排列。 当预测第 t t 帧的第 k k 个词元时，模型可以观察到所有前面的帧以及当前帧的前 k − 1 k-1 个词元，但看不到后面的词元。 因此，编码器遵循词元因果注意力，类似于传统的自回归 Transformer。

sents.en: In standard NTP, visual patches are ordered first temporally and then spatially.
sents.zh: 在标准 NTP 中，视觉块先按时间顺序排列，再按空间顺序排列。

sents.en: When predicting the k k -th token of frame t t , the model observes all preceding frames and the first k − 1 k-1 tokens of the current frame, but not later tokens.
sents.zh: 当预测第 t t 帧的第 k k 个词元时，模型可以观察到所有前面的帧以及当前帧的前 k − 1 k-1 个词元，但看不到后面的词元。

sents.en: The encoder therefore follows token-causal attention, analogous to a conventional autoregressive Transformer.
sents.zh: 因此，编码器遵循词元因果注意力，类似于传统的自回归 Transformer。

paragraphs.en: Next-frame prediction instead treats the entire frame as the prediction unit. All patches within an observed frame are jointly available, while no patch from the target frame is observed. Accordingly, the encoder uses frame-causal attention, allowing tokens to interact within each observed frame and attend to preceding frames, but not future frames. The target frame is then predicted jointly from the preceding observations.
paragraphs.zh: 逐帧预测则将整帧作为预测单元。 观测帧内的所有图像块是联合可用的，而目标帧中的任何图像块都未被观测到。 因此，编码器采用帧因果注意力，允许各观测帧内部的词元相互交互并关注先前的帧，但不能关注未来的帧。 目标帧随后基于先前的观测被联合预测出来。

sents.en: Next-frame prediction instead treats the entire frame as the prediction unit.
sents.zh: 逐帧预测则将整帧作为预测单元。

sents.en: All patches within an observed frame are jointly available, while no patch from the target frame is observed.
sents.zh: 观测帧内的所有图像块是联合可用的，而目标帧中的任何图像块都未被观测到。

sents.en: Accordingly, the encoder uses frame-causal attention, allowing tokens to interact within each observed frame and attend to preceding frames, but not future frames.
sents.zh: 因此，编码器采用帧因果注意力，允许各观测帧内部的词元相互交互并关注先前的帧，但不能关注未来的帧。

sents.en: The target frame is then predicted jointly from the preceding observations.
sents.zh: 目标帧随后基于先前的观测被联合预测出来。

paragraphs.en: Both variants use the same semantic and generative objectives and differ in how the visual sequence is factorized for prediction: NTP predicts successive visual tokens from prior tokens, whereas next-frame prediction predicts the next visual observation from preceding observations.
paragraphs.zh: 两种变体使用相同的语义和生成目标，区别在于视觉序列在预测时的分解方式：NTP 根据先前的视觉 token 预测后续的视觉 token，而下一帧预测则根据先前的观察结果预测下一个视觉观察结果。
